verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents online diff comparison with feedback left alongside the code, per-change review of stacked pull requests, and rulesets that can require reviews, so the core of online code review is covered. Reviews also exist as first-class data, appearing in GitHub import and MCP read tools. missing for 10: explicit documentation of replying to or resolving inline review comment threads, a dedicated pull-request review guide, independent or hands-on corroboration.
